description: This file contains the DocumentCommandValidator class, responsible for validating DocumentCommand objects during create and update operations within the document management component of the application.

classes.name: DocumentCommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ensuring the correctness and completeness of DocumentCommand objects before processing create or update operations.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates a DocumentCommand object for update operations, checking optional fields and consistency.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates a DocumentCommand object for create operations, ensuring required fields are present and valid.
